title: performance
description: Use this when you need a senior performance engineer (deepseek-flash) to identify and eliminate bottlenecks in applications, databases, and infrastructure via profiling, load testing, and measured optimization. Delegates broad discovery to `researcher`, uses GitNexus-first blast-radius analysis before touching hot-path code, and requires before/after measurement. Differentiate from `refactor`: this agent optimizes for speed/throughput with numbers; `refactor` optimizes for structure/maintainability.
author: sox-ecosystem
